s1.title: 1. Service overview
s1.body: TrimoAI is an online service for automatically generating short clips from YouTube or Twitch videos, with AI-generated subtitles. It is published by Maé Prina, individual entrepreneur, SIREN 107 735 698.

s2.title: 2. Acceptance of the Terms of Use
s2.body: By creating a TrimoAI account, you accept these Terms of Use. If you do not accept them, you must not use the service.

s3.title: 3. Access to the service
s3.body: TrimoAI is available to anyone with an account. You must be at least 15; between 15 and 18, a parent's consent is required to take out a paid subscription. The service is in beta: interruptions or slowdowns may occur.

s4.title: 4. Use of the service
items: use the service only for content you hold the rights to, or that is rights-free
not submit content that is illegal, defamatory, or infringes third-party rights
comply with the YouTube and Twitch terms of use
not attempt to circumvent the limits of the service
not use the service for unauthorized commercial purposes

s5.title: 5. Intellectual property
s5.body: You remain the owner of the content you submit, and you grant a temporary license to process it only in order to generate the clips you ask for. The generated clips belong to you. You are responsible for respecting the rights in the content you submit. If you hold rights in a video or clip processed through TrimoAI, you can report it on the “Report content” page: we review each report promptly and may remove the content or suspend the account concerned.

s6.title: 6. Subscriptions and payments
s6.body: The conditions of purchase, withdrawal and cancellation are set out in the Terms of Sale.

s7.title: 7. Liability
s7.body: The service is provided in beta; its availability and the quality of the clips may vary. We cannot be held liable where use is contrary to these Terms of Use. This clause does not limit consumers' statutory rights.

s8.title: 8. Suspension and termination
s8.body: You can delete your account at any time. In the event of a serious breach (unlawful content, infringement of third-party rights, circumvention of the limits), we may suspend your account after notifying you by email, except in an emergency. If the suspension is not justified, the unused share of the paid period is refunded to you.

s9.title: 9. Changes
